md:
---
name: git-rebase-recipe
description: "Rebases a feature branch onto main."
version: 0.1.0
author: AIJADE
platforms: ["macos", "linux"]
metadata:
  tags: ["Git", "Workflow"]
---

# Git Rebase

Keeps history linear.
Use with care.

## When to Use
- branch is behind main
- before opening a PR

## Prerequisites
- git >= 2.30

## How to Run
git rebase origin/main

## Quick Reference
- git fetch
- git rebase

## Procedure
1. git fetch origin
2. git rebase origin/main
3. resolve conflicts

## Pitfalls
- never rebase shared branches

## Verification
git log --oneline -5
